title: Per-extension admin icons + Discourse import verified
notes: Each add-on in the admin sidebar now has its own distinct icon instead of sharing the puzzle-piece. The Discourse importer is verified against a real Discourse 3.x instance and is no longer marked beta.

changelog.text: Admin sidebar: each extension gets its own icon instead of the shared puzzle-piece.
